body: Fixed in 211478e. The order book now records receipt time only when onData writes a WebSocket frame, clears it on resubscription, and returns null for a different subscription key. Cached levels stay visible during aggregation changes. A book that has never received a frame now shows Connecting without an Updated time. The default-aggregation provider drop remains follow-up work. Changed-file lint/typecheck, 269 affected tests, and the 19-node runtime recipe pass.
